summary: Bundled first-party executable Provider plugin binding Move AI to the built-in move-ai-s2 model Card. Contributes zero cards.
context_hints: This plugin never contributes a Card. move-ai-s2 is a Clash built-in Card owned in packages/shared-types; this package only ships the Provider, the one model-provider binding, and the executor that serves it.

move-ai-s2 takes no prompt. Exactly one reference in slot video is the only input, and Move AI's single-camera S2 mocap model always produces one animated, rigged GLB output (Move AI's MAIN_GLB output). upstreamModel is pinned to the literal string S2 by contract -- a submit for any other upstreamModel value fails invalid_request before any Provider request.

Move AI's upload flow (createFile -> presigned PUT -> createSingleCamTake -> createSingleCamJob, polled through getJob) requires raw bytes it can PUT directly. There is no 'give Move AI a URL and let it fetch' mode, so unlike most other plugins here a provider-url or executor-url resolved reference is rejected rather than fetched or forwarded -- only a bytes form with a supported video mediaType (video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/x-msvideo) reaches Move AI.

Submit validates structurally before doing any account or network work, in this order: (1) the invocation's own reference list must contain exactly one reference and it must be kind video, checked before context.reference is ever called; (2) upstreamModel === S2; (3) the account's apiKey is read from context.store; (4) trackFingers/floorPlane/trackBall are read from modelParams (or the top-level values as a fallback) and type-checked as booleans. Only after all four pass does context.reference resolve the video bytes.

Poll validates its durable pollState ({ jobId }) before reading the account's apiKey, exactly like every other plugin in this repo, so a corrupt journal entry fails independently of which account it belongs to. A completed job maps Move AI's MAIN_GLB presignedUrl to one ExecutorStep media output in slot media, kind model, mediaType model/gltf-binary. No secret, byte, or intermediate URL is ever carried in pollState -- it is exactly { jobId }.

subdirectories.providers: Move AI Provider declaration and secure API-key form.
subdirectories.bindings: model-provider-binding document routing move-ai-s2 to this Provider.
subdirectories.src: Typed stdio entrypoint, Move AI GraphQL HTTP client, reference resolution, and the submit/poll executor.

key_files.manifest.json: Versioned executable package and contribution declarations; contributes.cards is empty by contract.
key_files.providers/move-ai.json: Provider metadata, raw Authorization-header API-key form, and default asset-input representations.
key_files.bindings/move-ai-s2.json: Binds move-ai-s2 to Move AI's S2 single-cam mocap model, accepting only bytes-form video input.
key_files.src/move-ai-client.ts: Pure Move AI UGC GraphQL HTTP layer: request builders, envelope/HTTP error mapping, submit sequence, job poll.
key_files.src/move-ai-adapter.ts: Reference validation, order-of-operations (reference shape -> upstreamModel -> credentials -> option validation -> reference resolution), and the submit/poll Executor.
